description: Generate the PCB with the IterxAI desktop board engine (same code as the desktop app and its generate_board tool; runs headless in the IterxAI runtime when the desktop is closed). mode: plan is a read-only outline/placement comparison (outlines, planningPlacement; nothing written), prototype adopts the first-version board (prototypePlacement "search" re-places it), layout places and autoroutes (no manufacturing files), generate (default) / board write the routed board plus Gerber/drill/JLC package, reroute re-routes the saved placement. resumeManufacturing only rebuilds the manufacturing files from the saved board. Gate failures (e.g. FIRMWARE_REVALIDATION_REQUIRED, PROTOTYPE_REQUIRED) keep the saved board and return error.fix with the next step.

doubleSided.description: Allow components on both board sides.

handoffOnly.description: Same as resumeManufacturing (kept for older callers).

outlines.description: plan only: up to 8 candidate outlines [{id, outline}].

planningPlacement.description: plan only: "search" allows a bounded placement search.

process.description: Copper layers available to the router.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the IterxAI project directory (contains iterx.json). Defaults to the server cwd.

prototypePlacement.description: prototype: "search" re-places the parts (after a board outline or pad geometry change).

resumeManufacturing.description: Only rebuild Gerber/JLC files from the saved board (after layout reached quality complete, or a manufacturing blocker was fixed).

name: generate_board
